_comment: FLUX is the default: diffusion_model (your flux1-dev gguf) + clip_l (your diffusers CLIP) + t5xxl + vae (your diffusers VAE) — all loaded directly by the ErnosPlain FFI (verified: generated a 512x512 image). t5xxl is the single-file t5-v1_1-xxl (your copy is 2 shards; same weights). To fall back to single-file mode, remove diffusion_model and model_path (SDXL here) is used. The vision-describe step uses the agent's own model.
